notes.title: Yobowargames teams up with Slitherine/Matrix Games
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30902484/c6e03f1b3228549ebcc0f0a8e7fa0ac97787c6c6.jpg[/img]

Hi everybody!

We have exciting news for you.

[b]Yobowargames [/b]is teaming up with [b]Slitherine Ltd[/b]., to bring more traditional hex and counter war/historical themed board games to the digital world!

[b]Battle for Korsun[/b] and [b]Kursk - Battle at Prochorovka[/b] are now part of the Matrix/Slitherine Games catalog. 

To celebrate this important milestone, [b]Korsun has been updated to version 1.0.10 (Changelog below)[/b]

- Improved Minimap
- New button in top left to show/hide Minimap
- Mouse scroll will now show zoomed out view
- Selecting a stack of units will automatically select top unit. Previously would select the whole stack to move.
- Shift+left click to select whole stack
- Units that cannot move on turn one are now greyed out

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]
The 1.0.10 update for Korsun on available for Android while for iOS is coming soon.

notes.title: Patch 2.0.4 released
notes.content:
Hi All

Some of you have requested a zoom out feature and also the screen to center on AI attacks.

This patch provides a partial solution to both.

New in this release:

Pressing O/P keys while in game zooms the map in/out one level. This should make it easier to see what the AI is doing during its it turn and provide a better strategy level view

Enjoy

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Hi All

Just a short update on progress. 

I continue to work on implementing AI for the Russian side. The computer can now move and attack. Next comes the logic of what to do based on progress in the game. 

Well working on the AI I can see the game is a little unbalanced, favoring the Germans, so I am also working on balancing the game out with some tweaks. 

In addition I have made some minor changes based on feedback.

[list]
    [*]Holding down movement keys scrolls screen
    [*]Added Tooltips
    [*]Removed tick marks from battle display
[/list]

I will look to make other suggested changes as I come to them while working on the AI.

As always check out [url=yobowargames.com] yobowargames.com [/url] to see what else is happening.

notes.title: Game Update, Pricing Update and General News
notes.content:
I want to share with you where I am with this game, my thoughts on pricing strategy and news on other projects.

[h1]Game Update[/h1]

The present 1.3 release supports a hot seat game (two people at one PC playing alternate goes) or of course someone playing solo as both sides. I have not had any bugs reported in a considerable while and have received good suggestions for improvements to the game for future releases.

At present I am working on AI for the Russians and am hoping I will get a 1.4 version released around the beginning of June. After that update I will fix any issues found and look to officially release the game. 

I will then continue to support the game with the next release having AI for the Germans. If the game does well I will also look to support PBEM and continue to make other enhancements.

[h1]Pricing Strategy[/h1]

I believe early adopters should be rewarded in someway for their faith and input to a game – especially where it’s from some unknown developer of unknown quality and commitment. The best way I can do this is with the present reduced price while in Early Access. 

In the next week I intend to increase the price to $9.99 and at full release $12.99 (although on launch day probably there will be a discount of around 10%). 

I do not plan to put this game into any sale or bundle that would mean you could get it for a cheaper price than it is now. Certainly not for the next 2 years. 

[b][u]So if you want to get this game at a good price now’s the time to do it![/u][/b]

[h1]General News[/h1]

Since I put this game onto Greenlight and then Early Access a lot has happened behind the scenes. I have spoken to two Wargame publishers and have been able to reach out to game designers and be taken seriously due to this game. 

The results of this are that I now have a roadmap for my next few releases. Next up for the Eastern Front series will be “Battle for Korsun”. In addition I will kick off a West Front series with “Fall of France”.  No promise on when these will be available yet.

There will be hopefully other game announcements coming soon.

If you want to follow progress on these then please join up on the community at http://www.yobowargames.com/community/

[h1]Finally…[/h1]

I want to thank all the gamers who have purchased my game so far, for their fantastic support and comments, whether good or bad.

notes.title: 1.3 Update - Release Notes
notes.content:
[u]Please note saved games prior to this update will be lost. [/u]

[h1]New Features in this release[/h1]

[list]
    [*]New Main Menu
    [*]Nato Units
    [*]Logging
    [*]Victory Points status
    [*]wasd Keys now enabled for map movement
    [*]Version Number now shown on loading screen
[/list]

[h1]Fixed in this release[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Corrected spelling mistake in in game instructions
    [*]Corrected misalignment of text on Battle Report, if four units have been acted upon.
    [*]Speculative fix for CTD after loading game. 
[/list]

[h1]Details[/h1]

[b]Menu[/b]

Selectable scenarios - At present only one is enabled. 
Load Save games - Games are saved automatically at the end of every Turn (End of Russian combat phase). Unfortunately I needed to change the save game format and saved games prior to this update will be lost.
Option - Tick to enable Nato units. Preference will be saved for all future games

[b]Victory Points[/b]

At the beginning of every turn, except first turn, you will be shown present victory point status.

[b]Logging[/b]

Should you find an issue please contact me to help enable logging. Default is no logging.
